title: Avoid These Deal Killers When Buying an Accounting Practice
description:
Tired of buyers ghosting after due diligence? Or banks killing your deal days before closing?

In this episode of the DealMakers Podcast, I sit down with Jeff Bell of ABA Advisors—one of the most ethical and effective brokerages in the accounting practice world—to talk through real deal-breakers, red flags, and how to actually get to the closing table.

We cover:

✅ Why some buyers waste months of everyone's time
✅ What brokers and sellers are really looking for in a buyer
✅ The single biggest mistake financial buyers make (hint: it’s about staffing)
✅ How lawyers (yes, us!) can kill deals with delays and bloat
✅ What to ask your lender BEFORE you commit—and how banks quietly sabotage deals
✅ Why virtual firms are gold mines (and how to make your firm worth a premium)

Whether you’re a first-time buyer, seasoned broker, or just SBA-loan-curious, this episode is full of the hard truths and tactical tips most people don’t talk about.
